episode: Episode 10 · KitchenAid Classic vs Artisan vs Mini
title: Twelve Dozen Cookies
subtitle: Grandma June bakes for the whole street. Jo wants to buy her a stand mixer on Black Friday. Three of them look exactly alike.
end: Which mixer, and what price is worth it? The four models, side by side, are below.

items.text: One rule from KitchenAid's manual: yeast dough goes on speed 2. Never higher.
Higher speeds strain the motor. Speed 2, and patience.
Verdict Picks: KitchenAid Classic vs Artisan vs Mini, and the price to wait for.
